SELECT route.run_id, seat_type.id AS seat_type_id, seat_type.code AS seat_type_code, seat_type.name AS seat_type_name, fare.price, COALESCE(available.available_count, 0) AS available_count FROM ( SELECT tr.id AS run_id, tr.train_id, fs.stop_seq AS from_seq, ts.stop_seq AS to_seq FROM train_run tr JOIN train_stop fs ON fs.train_id = tr.train_id AND fs.station_id = #{fromStationId} JOIN train_stop ts ON ts.train_id = tr.train_id AND ts.station_id = #{toStationId} AND ts.stop_seq > fs.stop_seq WHERE tr.id IN
#{runId}
) route
JOIN train_fare fare ON fare.train_id = route.train_id AND fare.from_seq = route.from_seq AND fare.to_seq = route.to_seq
JOIN seat_type ON seat_type.id = fare.seat_type_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT seat_available.run_id, seat_available.seat_type_id, COUNT(*) AS available_count FROM ( SELECT tr.id AS run_id, coach.seat_type_id, seat.id AS seat_id FROM train_run tr
JOIN train_stop fs ON fs.train_id = tr.train_id AND fs.station_id = #{fromStationId}
JOIN train_stop ts ON ts.train_id = tr.train_id AND ts.station_id = #{toStationId} AND ts.stop_seq > fs.stop_seq
JOIN train_coach coach ON coach.train_id = tr.train_id
JOIN train_seat seat ON seat.coach_id = coach.id
JOIN seat_segment_inventory inventory ON inventory.run_id = tr.id AND inventory.seat_id = seat.id AND inventory.segment_seq >= fs.stop_seq AND inventory.segment_seq < ts.stop_seq
WHERE tr.id IN
#{runId}
GROUP BY tr.id, coach.seat_type_id, seat.id, fs.stop_seq, ts.stop_seq
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT inventory.segment_seq) = MAX(ts.stop_seq) - MAX(fs.stop_seq) AND COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN inventory.status = 'AVAILABLE' THEN inventory.segment_seq END ) = MAX(ts.stop_seq) - MAX(fs.stop_seq) ) seat_available
GROUP BY seat_available.run_id, seat_available.seat_type_id ) available ON available.run_id = route.run_id AND available.seat_type_id = fare.seat_type_id
ORDER BY route.run_id, seat_type.sort_no

SELECT DISTINCT transfer_station.id AS transfer_station_id, transfer_station.station_code AS transfer_station_code, transfer_station.name AS transfer_station,
first_run.id AS first_run_id, first_train.train_no AS first_train_no, first_train.train_type AS first_train_type, first_origin_station.name AS first_origin_station, first_terminal_station.name AS first_terminal_station, first_from_station.name AS first_from_station, transfer_station.name AS first_to_station, first_from_stop.stop_seq AS first_from_seq, first_transfer_stop.stop_seq AS first_to_seq,
TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( first_run.run_date, INTERVAL first_from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY ), first_from_stop.departure_time ) AS first_departure_date_time,
TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( first_run.run_date, INTERVAL first_transfer_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY ), first_transfer_stop.arrival_time ) AS first_arrival_date_time,
TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( first_run.run_date, INTERVAL first_from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY ), first_from_stop.departure_time ), TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( first_run.run_date, INTERVAL first_transfer_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY ), first_transfer_stop.arrival_time ) ) AS first_duration_minutes,
second_run.id AS second_run_id, second_train.train_no AS second_train_no, second_train.train_type AS second_train_type, second_origin_station.name AS second_origin_station, second_terminal_station.name AS second_terminal_station, transfer_station.name AS second_from_station, second_to_station.name AS second_to_station, second_transfer_stop.stop_seq AS second_from_seq, second_to_stop.stop_seq AS second_to_seq,
TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( second_run.run_date, INTERVAL second_transfer_stop.departure_day_offset DAY ), second_transfer_stop.departure_time ) AS second_departure_date_time,
TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( second_run.run_date, INTERVAL second_to_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY ), second_to_stop.arrival_time ) AS second_arrival_date_time,
TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( second_run.run_date, INTERVAL second_transfer_stop.departure_day_offset DAY ), second_transfer_stop.departure_time ), TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( second_run.run_date, INTERVAL second_to_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY ), second_to_stop.arrival_time ) ) AS second_duration_minutes,
TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( first_run.run_date, INTERVAL first_transfer_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY ), first_transfer_stop.arrival_time ), TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( second_run.run_date, INTERVAL second_transfer_stop.departure_day_offset DAY ), second_transfer_stop.departure_time ) ) AS wait_minutes,
TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( first_run.run_date, INTERVAL first_from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY ), first_from_stop.departure_time ), TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( second_run.run_date, INTERVAL second_to_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY ), second_to_stop.arrival_time ) ) AS total_duration_minutes
FROM train_run first_run
JOIN train first_train ON first_train.id = first_run.train_id AND first_train.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN train_stop first_from_stop ON first_from_stop.train_id = first_train.id AND first_from_stop.station_id = #{query.fromStationId}
JOIN station first_from_station ON first_from_station.id = first_from_stop.station_id
JOIN train_stop first_transfer_stop ON first_transfer_stop.train_id = first_train.id AND first_transfer_stop.stop_seq > first_from_stop.stop_seq AND first_transfer_stop.arrival_time IS NOT NULL
JOIN station transfer_station ON transfer_station.id = first_transfer_stop.station_id
/* * 第二程从第一程到达的换乘站出发。 */ JOIN train_stop second_transfer_stop ON second_transfer_stop.station_id = first_transfer_stop.station_id AND second_transfer_stop.departure_time IS NOT NULL
JOIN train second_train ON second_train.id = second_transfer_stop.train_id AND second_train.status = 'ACTIVE' AND second_train.id != first_train.id
JOIN train_run second_run ON second_run.train_id = second_train.id AND second_run.run_date BETWEEN #{query.travelDate} AND DATE_ADD(#{query.travelDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND second_run.sale_status = 'ON_SALE' AND second_run.inventory_initialized = 1 AND second_run.run_status != 'CANCELLED'
JOIN train_stop second_to_stop ON second_to_stop.train_id = second_train.id AND second_to_stop.station_id = #{query.toStationId} AND second_to_stop.stop_seq > second_transfer_stop.stop_seq AND second_to_stop.arrival_time IS NOT NULL
JOIN station second_to_station ON second_to_station.id = second_to_stop.station_id
JOIN station first_origin_station ON first_origin_station.id = first_train.origin_station_id
JOIN station first_terminal_station ON first_terminal_station.id = first_train.destination_station_id
JOIN station second_origin_station ON second_origin_station.id = second_train.origin_station_id
JOIN station second_terminal_station ON second_terminal_station.id = second_train.destination_station_id
WHERE first_run.run_date = #{query.travelDate} AND first_run.sale_status = 'ON_SALE' AND first_run.inventory_initialized = 1 AND first_run.run_status != 'CANCELLED' AND first_run.id != second_run.id AND transfer_station.id != #{query.fromStationId} AND transfer_station.id != #{query.toStationId}
/* * 第二程出发时间与第一程到达时间之间， * 必须满足用户指定的最短、最长换乘时间。 */ AND TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( first_run.run_date, INTERVAL first_transfer_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY ), first_transfer_stop.arrival_time ), TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( second_run.run_date, INTERVAL second_transfer_stop.departure_day_offset DAY ), second_transfer_stop.departure_time ) ) BETWEEN #{query.minTransferMinutes} AND #{query.maxTransferMinutes}
ORDER BY wait_minutes ASC, total_duration_minutes ASC, first_departure_date_time ASC
ORDER BY first_departure_date_time ASC, total_duration_minutes ASC
ORDER BY total_duration_minutes ASC, wait_minutes ASC, first_departure_date_time ASC

SELECT train_run.id AS run_id, train_run.run_date, train.train_no, train_stop.stop_seq, station.id AS station_id, station.station_code, station.name AS station_name,
CASE WHEN train_stop.arrival_time IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( train_run.run_date, INTERVAL train_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY ), train_stop.arrival_time ) END AS arrival_date_time,
CASE WHEN train_stop.departure_time IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD( train_run.run_date, INTERVAL train_stop.departure_day_offset DAY ), train_stop.departure_time ) END AS departure_date_time,
train_stop.stop_minutes, train_stop.distance_km,
CASE WHEN train_stop.stop_seq = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS origin,
CASE WHEN train_stop.stop_seq = ( SELECT MAX(last_stop.stop_seq) FROM train_stop last_stop WHERE last_stop.train_id = train.id ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS terminal
FROM train_run JOIN train ON train.id = train_run.train_id JOIN train_stop ON train_stop.train_id = train.id JOIN station ON station.id = train_stop.station_id
WHERE train_run.id = #{runId} ORDER BY train_stop.stop_seq ASC

SELECT tr.id AS run_id, tr.train_id, tr.sale_status, tr.inventory_initialized, t.train_no, from_stop.station_id AS from_station_id, to_stop.station_id AS to_station_id, from_stop.stop_seq AS from_seq, to_stop.stop_seq AS to_seq, TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD(tr.run_date, INTERVAL from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY), from_stop.departure_time ) AS departure_date_time, TIMESTAMP( DATE_ADD(tr.run_date, INTERVAL to_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY), to_stop.arrival_time ) AS arrival_date_time FROM train_run tr INNER JOIN train t ON t.id = tr.train_id INNER JOIN train_stop from_stop ON from_stop.train_id = tr.train_id AND from_stop.station_id = #{fromStationId} INNER JOIN train_stop to_stop ON to_stop.train_id = tr.train_id AND to_stop.station_id = #{toStationId} WHERE tr.id = #{runId} AND from_stop.stop_seq < to_stop.stop_seq AND from_stop.departure_time IS NOT NULL AND to_stop.arrival_time IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM seat_type WHERE code = #{seatTypeCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM seat_type WHERE id = #{seatTypeId} LIMIT 1
